scores.tell: Wood and roof planks are painted flat with smooth airbrushed faces. Seed pile and bark are a bit busy. Fine wood grain is missing.
none. The rope has fine twist ridges, and the satin finish and soft shading match the real towel and saddle cards.
Plush bear has stitching, but its fur is flat painted. The shelf wood is smooth and plasticky. The target is evenly glossy.
Telescope tube is uniformly glossy. Tripod legs are smooth orange tubes with no grain. Plank floor is clean and decorative.
Gold is uniformly polished with big clean facets. Bevels are crisp and the gem is a plain glossy dot. It reads a little toy-like.
none. The keys have soft matte rubber texture and the screen is glossy. Gloss range is mixed, like the real cards.
Water is heavily detailed with caustics and the sand has fine noise. The wood is smooth with small nail dots. The rope is detailed. Overall it is more painterly than the real cards.
Coral is one uniform glossy clay or plastic with bumps. It has no matte and shiny contrast, and no fine detail. The rocks are smooth.
Metal truss and housing read as satin metal. Lens glints and rim highlights are correct. The tell is slightly smooth, uniform paint on the housing.
Cooler, cans and ice are all high-gloss plastic with specular dots. Water, sand and leaves are all equally lacquered. The starfish has glossy bumps.
